title: DomainEvent
description: Spec-ahead (ADR 0005). Ordered, append-only fact per owner, written only by the worker; projections are rebuilt from these. Firestore: owners/{ownerId}/events/{seq}. No code anchor yet; moves to schemas/ once implemented.

seq.description: Strictly increasing per ownerId; assigned by the worker in a transaction

actor.description: system = derived by the pipeline; user = from a user command

causationId.description: RawEvent id this event was derived from

lineItems.description: Coarse: one import carries all its items

targetEventSeq.description: For confirmed/corrected/dismissed: the event acted on

data.description: Type-specific fields, e.g. a correction's changed fields or a transfer's target collectionId
